ex.s: Hospital patients Who see tree branches out their window are likely to recover at a faster rate than patients who see buildings or sky instead.
ex.src: 2019全国I卷·Is Fresh Air Really Good for You?
ex.t: 从窗户能看到树枝的医院病人，康复速度可能比看建筑和天空的病人更快。

ex.s: Long curtains had been pulled around my bed,  16  me from the other patients.
ex.t: 长窗帘已经被拉到我的床边，16 把我和其他病人隔开。

ex.s: On a typical day, we spend our time cheering up patients, their families, and more often than not, the hospital staff, too!
ex.t: 在一个典型的日子里，我们会花时间为患者、他们的家人以及医院工作人员欢呼雀跃！

ex.s: But, although the death rate is very high, we will never give up on a patient, and our efforts do sometimes end in miracles.
ex.t: 但是，尽管死亡率很高，我们永远不会放弃一个病人，而我们的努力有时确实会以奇迹告终。

ex.s: He benefited from it as a patient.
ex.t: 他作为患者从中受益。

ex.s: On the other side of my bed curtain, I heard a patient cheerfully  18  every nurse as they entered the room, as if welcoming each into his home.
ex.t: 在我的床帘另一边，我听到一位病人愉快地18 每一位进来的护士，仿佛欢迎她们来到他的家中。

ex.s: “The technologist must build up a story with the patient," Ms L'Ecuyer said.

ex.s: Parry quickly graduated from his early hearts and sharks, and started to surprise families with drawings that captured young patients’ personalities.
ex.t: 帕里很快不再画最初的心形和鲨鱼，而是开始用捕捉小患者个性的画作给各个家庭带来惊喜。

ex.s: "The patient is left with the power to choose what he wants to talk about.

defs.def: a person who receives treatment from a particular doctor, dentist, etc. （某个医生或牙医等的）病人

ex.s: Doctors see up to 150 patients every day.
ex.t: 医生每天最多接诊150名病人。

ex.s: We have to be very sensitive and work closely with the doctors and nurses, who keep us updated on each patient.
ex.t: 我们必须非常敏感，并与医生和护士密切合作，他们随时向我们报告每个病人的最新情况。

ex.s: There are no borders for doctors, for patients or for anyone else involved in combating this terrible disease.
ex.t: 对医生、对患者，或对任何参与抗击这种可怕疾病的人来说，都没有国界之分。

ex.s: It tells what doctors are doing to the patient.
ex.t: 它告诉医生在对患者做什么。

ex.s: The ability to accurately understand how others are feeling may be used by a doctor to find how best to help her patients, while a cheater might use it to control potential victims.
ex.t: 准确理解他人感受的能力，医生可以用来找到最好地帮助病人的方法，而骗子可能用它来控制潜在受害者。

ex.s: Doctor and patient.
ex.t: 医患关系。

defs.def: the person or thing that is affected by the action of the verb. In the sentence ‘I started the car’, the patient is car. 受动者

ex.s: After that I poured oil into a pan and turned off the stove, I waited patiently unless the oil was hot.
ex.t: 之后我把油倒进锅里并关了火，我耐心地等着，直到油热。

ex.s: The last Covid-19 patient in Wuhan was discharged from hospital.
ex.t: 世卫组织-中国新冠联合专家组举行了新闻发布会。

ex.s: The technologist will guide the patient to this modified state—an imaginary world that will disassociate itself more and more from the procedure that follows.
ex.t: 技师会引导患者进入这种改变后的状态——一个想象中的世界，它将越来越脱离随后的操作过程。

ex.s: “The important thing is that the technologist associates what is happening outside the patient's body with what the patient sees in his head," Ms L'Ecuyer said.
ex.t: "重要的是技术员要将患者身体外发生的情况与患者脑海中看到的内容联系起来，"勒屈耶女士说。

ex.s: In the cafe, the couple bought Emily a hot chocolate and listened patiently as she explained her desperate situation: she was about a hundred miles from her destination, her car was completely stuck, and her entire holiday plan could be ruined.
ex.t: 在咖啡馆里，那对夫妇给 Emily 买了一杯热巧克力，并耐心地听她解释自己绝望的处境：她离目的地约有一百英里，车完全陷住了，整个假期计划可能毁于一旦。

ex.s: The researchers observed that the dogs were much more patient, making more eye contact and staying closer to the screen after the “unable” scenario played out.
ex.t: 研究人员观察到，在“不能”的情景播放后，这些狗表现得更有耐心，更多地进行眼神交流，并更靠近屏幕。
